adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review completed source-backed reconciliation for doi__10.3390_antibiotics10010036. XML Tables 1-3, Figure captions 2-5, PDF text, supplement text, and linked DBAASP/DRAMP rows were reopened; source-supported values were moved into final activity/database/mechanism artifacts, and remaining database disagreements are preserved as cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: A. baumannii database rows use ATCC 7978 while the methods identify ATCC17978; Enterobacter/Klebsiella aerogenes nomenclature differs from the primary paper wording.

Some DBAASP Table 2 MIC rows omit salt/serum condition, and some HepG2/Galleria categorical rows are broader or more exact than the local text supports; source-supported values are preserved in final activity records.
DRAMP rows for C13/C16/C18/C22 include an Anticancer activity label; the primary paper supports antimicrobial activity and HepG2 toxicity screening, not anticancer efficacy.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database artifacts were sufficient for obtainable-only publication-grade adjudication with preserved database cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: 432 linked database rows were reviewed against primary tables/figures/metadata; source_conflict rows preserve target-name, condition, figure-category, or DRAMP-label disagreements instead of being normalized away.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 223 source-supported final activity/toxicity records were regenerated from Table 1, Table 2, Table 3, Figure 4, and Figure 5; supplement Table S1/S2 does not add activity endpoints.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims were rewritten as source-located direct assays or functional context with explicit assay types and limitations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_review: The prior generic worker-6 ticket is closed because the missing source-reviewed adjudication and database conflict preservation have been completed.

summary: C18 and related Cec4-derived peptides are now curated from local primary material; C18 remains the lead peptide with broad Table 1 MIC support, Table 3 daptomycin synergy, membrane/DNA/biofilm mechanism context, and Galleria efficacy, while database-only overreach is retained as caution evidence.
